overview: Everything that eats, poops. Animals, players, villagers and bats leave piles, the piles rot down into fertiliser, and the shovelling is worth something.

1.3.0: /poop does what the keybind does, so a plain client can go when it needs to.
There is a button for it in the action menu as well.
1.2.0: Muck landing on bare tilled ground sows a crop, drawn from whatever is growing nearby.
A heap sitting on a block of the same stuff stops rotting, so a midden keeps.
1.1.0: A heap climbs the full eight layers where something holds it in; the ninth packs it into a block.
A bed accident leaves a pile on the mattress.
Guano stops rotting, so a roost builds a bed worth quarrying.
The bat box says which of sky, room or water is stopping it.
1.0.0: The whole cycle: piles that spread before they stack, and a digestive tract on the HUD.
Village latrines and the quests that go with them.
Bat boxes and guano, throwable poop that fertilises where it lands, and dung-fired furnaces.
